role: Progress reporting, notification throttling and terminal UI truth

scope.application_commit_reviewed: e625ee7; concurrent network/runtime working-tree fixes present
scope.method: Read-only static control-flow review. No source edits, build, test execution, device interaction or publication.

verified_observations: NotificationGate immediately accepts phase changes and limits same-phase notify calls to one per second. DownloadService.publish updates Transfers before applying this notification gate, so notification throttling does not throttle StateFlow UI progress.

Direct and parallel transfer loops emit periodic progress at approximately 250ms intervals and emit final byte progress after successful completion; NativeProcessSession throttles percentage callbacks to 250ms while processing transitions bypass that interval.
TransferProcessor sets COMPLETE at the publication commit callback, preserves it when cancellation is caught, and updates terminal Transfers state in NonCancellable finalization.
Cancellation reaches direct calls, parallel workers and the native process session through DownloadService.cancelTransfer; no measured resource/battery claim is inferred from these static bounds.
limitations: Additional unit-test reference reads planned in the first pass were blocked when automatic approval review hit a usage limit; that review failure later recovered. No additional runtime tests were performed.
Review is based on completed source reads, with an additional refreshed complete DownloadService read during reviewer53; concurrent edits may change the final tree.
No notification delivery timing, battery use, CPU use, network throughput or cancellation latency was measured.
Maximum-two finding cap yielded zero proven actionable defects in this narrow scope.
